screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.title: Shhh Builder - How to Use
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page1.title: 1. Getting Started
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page1.line1: A starter house (sample_house.litematic) is ready for you right now!
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page1.line2: You can also put your own .litematic or .schem files into the folder.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page1.line3: Click 'Open Folder' on the main screen to open it on your PC.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page1.line4: Whenever you add new files, press 'Refresh' to update the list.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page2.title: 2. Pick a Build
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page2.line1: Click any build in the list on the left (try sample_house!).
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page2.line2: The selected build is marked with a gold arrow (▶) and yellow text.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page2.line3: The Blocks Needed tab on the right shows its size and materials.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page2.line4: Check the list to see exactly which blocks and stacks you need.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page3.title: 3. Collect Your Materials
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page3.line1: Press %s or click 'Checklist' on the main screen to open the checklist.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page3.line2: See exact items needed, with stack counts and shulker box math.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page3.line3: Check off items as you gather them, or let auto-inventory check them.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page3.line4: Use layer buttons ([◀] [▶]) to gather materials floor by floor.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page4.title: 4. Place It in Your World
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page4.line1: Stand where you want the bottom corner of your build to start.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page4.line2: Click 'Place Here' at the bottom right to anchor the build.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page4.line3: A bright cyan box appears showing the full outer footprint.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page4.line4: Real see-through textured preview blocks show where every block goes (adjust Opacity [-] [+] live or in Settings).
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page5.title: 5. Move and Turn It
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page5.line1: Use the Move & Turn tab buttons on-screen to adjust your build.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page5.line2: Or use keys: Arrow keys move forward, backward, left, and right.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page5.line3: Page Up and Page Down move the build 1 block up or down.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page5.line4: Press %s to turn 90° clockwise, and %s to flip left-right.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page6.title: 6. Build Floor by Floor
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page6.line1: Press %s to switch layer mode: All, One layer, or Up to layer.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page6.line2: Press %s and %s to step the visible layer down and up.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page6.line3: Press %s to instantly show all layers again.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page6.line4: Press %s to show or hide the blocks needed list while building.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.title: 7. Good to Know
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.line1: Outlines are only a visual guide. The mod never places blocks for you.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.line2: Place real blocks by right-clicking existing faces into the wireframes.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.line3: Press %s to toggle preview blocks, and %s to toggle the outline box.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.line4: Customize opacity, block borders, and quality presets (Low/Balanced/High) in Mod Menu settings.
screen.shhh-builder.tutorial.page7.line5: Prefer chat commands? Type /shhhbuilder help for all commands.
